identification: Mid-Victorian style (c1860-1880, catalogued Edwardian) burr walnut four-tier serpentine-front corner whatnot: figured burr walnut veneered shelves with boxwood (light) line stringing, shaped three-sided top gallery with floral marquetry scrolls and central turned finial, barley-twist (spiral) supports between tiers, turned urn finials at each corner, turned feet, small carved apron under the bottom shelf. H 123 cm per catalogue. Armitage estimate A$80-120.
